subject: English Home Language

source.subtopic: Recognises 3-letter consonant blends at the end of words (ca-tch, fe-tch, i-tch)

show.line: Catch, fetch, itch, match. Listen to the end. Catch! Three letters make that ending sound.

rounds.prompt: What is this? It ends like catch.
Which three letters end the word itch?
rounds.praise: Yes! Those three letters end itch.

rounds.story: Dumi throws the ball. His dog runs to fetch it. What does the dog do?
rounds.praise: Yes! The dog fetches the ball.

rounds.prompt: Ends like catch, or ends like fish? Put each picture in its group.

hints: Say the word slowly. Listen to the very end.
Catch, fetch, itch. Does the word end like that?

beat_the_tutor.setup: My turn! I will find a word that ends like catch.
beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! Cat ends with tuh. Match ends like catch.
beat_the_tutor.gentle_line: Let's listen together. Catch, match. Same ending!

parent_line: Can hear and read the tch ending in words like catch and fetch.
